newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 2.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 2.

text.p: Here are the main headlines from Lithuania's M-1 plus radio station's noon news report on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Parliamentary chairman Vytautas Landsbergis urged tNATO countries to mention Lithuania in the official documents of the July summit in Madrid. If they don't, he said Russia might be led to believe that the country has been left in a "grey zone" of security.
- The Preisdent of Turkey Suleyman Demireli started his two-day official visit to Lithuania on Monday. The two countries will pay major attention to the development of economic co-operation.
- The Eurosceptics movement was founded in Lithuania on Saturday. The new organisation opposes Lithuanian membership in the EU but supports the country's bid to join NATO.
